calculation_handling.description: Where the lawful separation between main walls of lawfully existing buildings on a lot (or within one such building) is less than the by-law requires, that lawful existing separation becomes the minimum for those walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Sets the minimum to an as-built value. The DSL existing(...) form needs a date or enactment the text does not give, so no expression is written and the unit is keyed as a DEFINE of separation_m rather than a LIMIT. Needs as-built separation data we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Existing buildings whose walls are closer together than today's rules allow may keep that existing distance. We do not hold as-built wall separations.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building covered by (1) must meet the minimum main-wall separation in 10.10.40.80(1) or be authorized by a minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'Section 45' is a statutory section number, not a literal. Applies only to existing buildings relying on (1).

units.disclosure: Additions to such existing buildings must meet the normal wall-separation rule or get a minor variance. We cannot confirm whether a building relies on the existing-separation exemption.

10.10.40.81(1).explanation: In the R zone, if existing lawful buildings have main walls closer together than the by-law now requires, that existing distance is accepted as the minimum for those walls.

10.10.40.81(2).explanation: Any addition to one of those buildings must meet the normal minimum separation between main walls (10.10.40.80(1)), or be approved through a minor variance.
